description: Nicomachus retroactively catalogs photo assets from December 27th, 2025.

entries.description: Diptych illustration comparing 'Botanical AL' (green, nature-integrated, externalized neg-entropy) with 'Animal AL' (grey, industrial, internalized neg-entropy feeding on botanical AL).
